evals.name: student-my-capstone-upload-directions
evals.prompt: A student respondent reported: 'There should be a directions in my capstone tab so handling the capstone documents during uploading or submissions is clear.' Using our skill, identify which React pages/components need updating, what directions must be surfaced without breaking collapsed defaults, and what routes the quick actions should link to.
evals.expected_output: Identifies client/src/pages/projects/MyProjectPage.jsx (capstone_1 tab above Capstone1CollapsibleSections) and expanded student chapter grid in Capstone1CollapsibleSections.jsx, keeps initial accordion state collapsed, explains sequential Ch. 1-3 uploads (<=25MB, <25% similarity), and links to /project/submissions and /project/submissions/upload.
assertions: References MyProjectPage.jsx capstone_1 tab and Capstone1CollapsibleSections.jsx
Preserves initial collapsed state for Capstone1CollapsibleSections
Surfaces sequential Ch. 1-3 upload directions and links to /project/submissions and /project/submissions/upload

evals.name: cross-role-dashboard-feature-discovery
evals.prompt: Usability Item 2 ('dashboard makes it easy to locate the features relevant to my role') scored 4.27 and faculty commented the interface should not confuse non-tech-savvy users. Design a cross-role dashboard navigation improvement across Student, Faculty, and Instructor roles without violating Router/unit-test constraints.
evals.expected_output: Adds Role Quick-Actions Bar on StudentDashboard (DashboardPage.jsx), plain-language Faculty Role Guide & Quick-Jump Bar across Adviser/Panelist/Secretary views (FacultyDashboard.jsx) without triggering button-label test collisions on 'Review', and static-anchor Instructor quick actions (InstructorDashboard.jsx) avoiding unmocked useNavigate calls.
assertions: Covers Student, Faculty (Adviser/Panelist/Secretary), and Instructor dashboards
Avoids button label collision on 'Review' in FacultyDashboard
Avoids calling useNavigate directly inside InstructorDashboard because its test renders without MemoryRouter

evals.name: file-management-and-browser-walkthrough
evals.prompt: Faculty asked to improve the file management feature and make the system easier to navigate. Plan the improvements in Submissions and Cloud Documents pages and specify a live multi-role browser walkthrough plan using canonical accounts.
evals.expected_output: Updates ProjectSubmissionsPage.jsx with Phase Quick-Jump & Upload Guide Bar (#phase-2-capstone-1..#phase-4-capstone-3) and TemplateManagementPage.jsx (/documents/manuscripts) with File Organization & Quick Navigation Bar (sticking to mocked Lucide icons), plus a Playwright walkthrough across student@student.buksu.edu.ph, adviser@student.buksu.edu.ph, and instructor@student.buksu.edu.ph.
assertions: Includes phase anchor jumps and Cloud Sync link in ProjectSubmissionsPage.jsx
Respects the 6 mocked lucide-react icons in TemplateManagementPage.test.jsx
Defines browser walkthrough steps on http://localhost:43211 using canonical accounts and domcontentloaded
